observations: White front-loading washing machine with circular door and top control panel.
"SAMSUNG" brand name printed on upper left of console.
"eco bubble 9.0kg" printed on lower right of console.
Control dial and program buttons visible; screen is dark.
"12 WARRANTY" badge on left door frame; "10 WARRANTY" badge on right.

risks.proof: video of spin cycle with load

risks.risk: Control panel or program selector faults

Close-up video of rear hoses, pump filter, and door seal for leaks or damage

response.reason: The washing machine is identifiable from photo 0 as a Samsung Eco Bubble 9kg front loader; its unproven working condition means it can be priced at its worst case as scrap or for repair.
